item.title: Version 2.6
item.description:
iPod Drop 2.6

  • Faster uploads. Songs already on your iPod are skipped instantly, several files are prepared and converted at once, and each new song is checked once after copying instead of five times. That's most of the wait on a hard-drive iPod.
  • Undo removals. Songs you remove from the iPod are kept on your Mac for 30 days. Choose File › Recently Removed Songs… to add them back. Your iPod's library is also backed up before every change.
  • Welcome guide. A short guide on first launch covers connecting your iPod, allowing access to it, and adding music. Find it any time in Help.
